meta.name: desktop
meta.description: Grida Desktop Electron shell and release-impact work: BrowserWindow, preload, `window.grida`, menus, protocol/deep links, file associations, Forge, path-scoped bridge security, Electron-only UI bugs, and CDP / Playwright verification. Use for `desktop/`, `editor/app/desktop/**`, `editor/scaffolds/desktop/**`, `editor/lib/desktop/**`, `/desktop/*` CSP, GRIDA-SEC-004, and deciding whether linked-package or hosted-renderer changes require a native Desktop version bump or coordinated release. For implementing daemon/agent-tenant core behavior, use `agent-system` as well.

copy.tagline: 构建和调试 Electron 桌面应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发或维护 Electron 桌面应用。
copy.tagline_en: Build and debug Electron desktop applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop or maintain Electron desktop apps.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理 Grida 桌面版 Electron 外壳的代码，包括主进程、窗口、菜单、预加载脚本、协议链接、文件关联、打包配置，以及 Electron 专属的 UI 问题。它还能通过 CDP/Playwright 验证桌面应用，并判断代码改动是否需要发布新的桌面版本。
howto.when: 当你需要修改 `desktop/` 目录下的 Electron 代码，或者处理只在 Electron 中出现的渲染器问题时触发。也适用于审计桌面版本发布影响。

say.text: 帮我检查桌面版 Electron 的预加载脚本是否安全。
